what_happened: Confirmed via direct re-execution of plan-file-scope-harvest.sh against the real archived #417 plan that the harvester's grammar already matches plan-format.md's documented 'one path per Files-to-modify line' contract exactly; the 4 missing paths were a plan-authoring deviation (comma-join and wrapped-continuation lines), not a harvester bug. Rejected widening the harvester's token scan because the same block contains non-path backtick tokens (a quoted markdown heading, a bare basename missing its directory) that would become garbage file_scope entries.

Discovered a live, present-day loophole while root-causing the #424 citation: archived task 424's file_scope still holds the literal entry '.claude/' (harvested from that plan's own Phase 4 Files-to-modify block, which named .claude/ directly instead of plan-format.md's reserved __WHOLE_TREE__ sentinel). Empirically re-tested today's (already-fixed, post-2a945dca3) is_contained() trailing-slash normalization against this entry: it now judges every .claude/** path as CONTAINED, the inverse of the Hard Constraint's intent. Neither plan-file-scope-harvest.sh nor validate-artifact.sh currently refuses a harvested .claude/** path. Recorded as a PART A recommendation (harvester refusal + validate-artifact.sh advisory check) in the research report rather than fixed here (research-only dispatch).

The research report's per-citation verdict table and its five numbered Decisions mapped one-to-one onto phase boundaries with no re-derivation: the only new plan-stage work was (1) re-measuring suite_selection_select per phase for Tier Justifications and (2) discovering a third leak path the report did not name (propose_file_scope_addition() can itself deposit a .claude/** path into proposed_file_scope, which implement-postflight then merges into state.json's file_scope) -- folded into Phase 3 as a deposit-site refusal.
